exposure: early amniotomy (initiating induction of labor with amniotomy followed by oxytocin)
delayed amniotomy (initiating induction of labor with oxytocin followed by amniotomy 4-8 hours later)
outcome: proportion of women delivering within 12 hours
cohort: 150 women with a Bishop's score of ≥6 undergoing induction of labor
finding: Early amniotomy reduced the induction-delivery interval but resulted in a higher cesarean section rate.
